reply: For monitoring fat and protein in your opaque, concentrated milk product, NIR (diffuse reflection) is a suitable primary method. It is effective for inline analysis of opaque dairy products and can be integrated into your processing line with a fiber optic probe. Consider a comparison with Raman spectroscopy to assess any additional benefits, particularly if fluorescence interference is minimal.
